title: I made a daily creative writing + prompting game where Jev is the judge (free to play, compete on custom group or global leaderboards)
author: Friendly_Imps
selftext:
I made [abstractle.com](http://abstractle.com) for 2 reasons - I want to see all the creative things people write, and I want to see how people learn to play the judge.   
  
Abstractle uses a series of carefully calibrated Jev prompts to score your description of the day's target (today is Autumn, give it a try!) along 2 axes - Accurate and Poetic. Compete on the global leaderboard, or easily create a private group leaderboard to compete with your friends or just get to see what they write.  
  
Happy to share more about the specific judging rubric or working with Jev.

Thanks for playing! Sam
